Linda Gustafsson  
+46 762 345 678 | linda.gustafsson@email.com | Stockholm, Sweden | linkedin.com/in/lindagustafsson  

A seasoned QA engineer with a decade of experience shaping test frameworks, leading cross-functional teams, and architecting scalable automation solutions for healthcare platforms. Known for driving measurable improvements in system reliability and reducing critical defect resolution times by 40% across multiple product lines. My work bridges technical rigor with business impact, ensuring compliance, performance, and user-centric outcomes in high-stakes environments.  

**Senior QA Engineer | HealthSphere Solutions** (2021–present)  
Led the redesign of end-to-end test automation for a flagship telehealth platform, reducing regression cycle times by 35% through modular script architecture. Spearheaded API testing strategies for 12+ integrations with NHS systems, ensuring 99.9% uptime during peak usage. Mentored 5 junior engineers, standardizing practices that cut manual test hours by 25% across teams.  

**Senior Test Engineer | HealthGuard Inc.** (2019–2021)  
Architected a cloud-native test framework supporting 20+ microservices, enabling parallel execution and reducing deployment risks by 50%. Designed a Python-based toolchain for parsing unstructured medical data, integrating with CI/CD pipelines to automate 80% of data validation checks.  

**Test Lead | VitalCare Systems** (2017–2019)  
Overhauled test strategy for a hospital management system, aligning with ISO 13485 standards. Introduced Playwright-based end-to-end testing for web interfaces, improving defect detection rates by 60% pre-release. Collaborated with security teams to integrate compliance checks into automation, eliminating manual audits.  

**QA Engineer | MedTech Solutions** (2016–2017)  
Built foundational automation frameworks for medical device software, achieving 95% test coverage for core workflows. Pioneered Python scripts for parsing clinical trial data, reducing manual reporting time by 40% and enabling real-time analytics for stakeholders.  

**Technical Skills**  
Python: Developed data validation pipelines for medical records, integrated with Elasticsearch for analytics. Automated 70% of regression tests for a cloud-based EHR system using Python scripts.  
Selenium/Playwright: Engineered browser automation for a telehealth app, supporting cross-browser compatibility and dynamic content rendering. Created reusable locators for 15+ web components, reducing maintenance efforts.  
Test Strategy Design: Spearheaded a shift-left approach for a diagnostics platform, embedding testing into development sprints and reducing post-release issues by 30%.  
API Testing: Architectured a framework for testing RESTful services in a health data exchange, ensuring 100% compliance with HL7 standards. Mentored teams on crafting test cases for edge scenarios, improving integration stability.  
Test Automation: Redesigned a monolithic test suite into microservices, enabling parallel execution and reducing runtime by 50%. Championed CI/CD integration, automating 90% of test execution for nightly builds.  

**Education**  
Master’s in Software Engineering | Chalmers University of Technology | 2018  

**Languages**  
English (native), Swedish (fluent), French (basic)  

**Certifications**  
Selenium Certification (2020), ISTQB Foundation Level (2019), DevOps for Healthcare (2022)
